# SimpleMoney

> SimpleMoney is a free, private, offline-first expense manager and budget planner for Android. It reads bank SMS alerts on the phone, tracks loans, EMIs, debts, subscriptions and multi-currency accounts, needs no account, and has an optional AI assistant that connects Claude or ChatGPT over MCP. Made by Aash Global.

Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aash591.SimpleMoney

## Key facts
- Platform: Android. No account needed. Works offline.
- Free to track money. SimpleMoney Pro adds unlimited budgets, all looks, the AI assistant and removes ads.
- Bank SMS is read on the device and is not uploaded.
- Backups go to the user's own Google Drive and can be encrypted (AES-256-GCM, key from a PIN that is never stored).
- The AI assistant only suggests changes. The user approves each one in the app.
